title: Beginnings
credit: Original desk walk through Genesis 1, Job 38, the Mazzaroth, and a Budge sample. Not a modern creation PDF.

sections.title: Genesis 1:14
paragraphs: Lights in the expanse are for signs, seasons, days, and years. Heavens on this desk treats those lights as a clock, not as a birth chart.
Open Genesis 1, then Job 38:31–33 (Mazzaroth, Arcturus, Orion, Pleiades), then Psalm 19. The Book of the Dead sample is an Egyptian hymn of coming forth, not Scripture.

sections.title: Job 38
paragraphs: The Lord questions Job about the sky’s ordinances. That is the cornerstone for the Mazzaroth wheel. Egyptian funerary hymns ask other questions. Keep the two shelves labeled.

sections.title: The Name in the letters
paragraphs: Some later study maps look for Yod He Vav He in created things. This desk counts the four letters in Gematria and stops there. Hebrews 11:3 and John 1:1–3 already say the worlds were framed by the word.
